'''Hak Soo Kim''' made the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] final twelve. Kim qualified through Coruscant Rochester from San Francisco, California.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="trando">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/wf00p2.htm History of the World Finals], [[Trandosite]].</ref> Kim published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs and won the [[1997 Corellia Regionals (Columbus)]].

* [[Hak Soo Kim Anti-Revolution]] (DS, July 1996)

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"Age, 21."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/kim.html Hak Soo Kim], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427221014/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/kim.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"Atending the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm a techno music aficionado, apprenticing to a master in the art of DJ'ing."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Star Wars movie is The Empire Strikes Back."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"It has animal innards, incestuous love, torture, political pragmatism, dismemberment - what more could you want from a movie?"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My Star Wars CCG philosophy is 'Control."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"First, control the sense/alter war."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Second, make your opponent react to what you do; not the other way around."<ref name="dec97bio" />
